errors.text: The cited studies do not establish the claimed low-coercivity single-phase fcc Fe-Co-Ni-Ti baseline or support Ti-rich Ti2Ni/TiFe precipitates as the proposed magnetic intervention.
The assertion that Ti-rich interfaces provide strong spin-orbit coupling and restore orbital moments is unsupported and chemically questionable for Ti.
The hypothesis misses the compositionally segregated C14 Laves phase and antiferromagnetic Ti-sublattice coupling central to the target mechanism.
